title: HQ reversion: h1 vx (H1 pick)
question: Owner 2026-10-23: a strategy that trades 2+ times a week with high-quality, high-probability, high-profit setups - mean reversion at exhaustion (stretched range / both sides swept / stretched into a HTF pool / failed ORB).
verdict: $500 risk, costs in. H1: 29 trades (1.13/wk), true win 65.5%, PF 1.62, net +3,228 ($530/mo), DD -1,667. H2: 11 trades (0.71/wk), true win 27.3%, PF 0.36, net -2,505 ($-674/mo), DD -2,989. 2025: 73 trades (1.41/wk), true win 56.2%, PF 1.24, net +3,570 ($291/mo), DD -2,149. 2021-24: 227 trades (1.39/wk), true win 51.5%, PF 0.94, net -3,438 ($-89/mo), DD -10,053. Evals (pass/fail-or-dead %): H1 25K alone 2-wk 5.0/0.0, next to LIT on the 50K 57.1/2.5; H2 25K alone 2-wk 0.0/0.0, next to LIT on the 50K 50.7/4.3; 2025 25K alone 2-wk 2.4/1.2, next to LIT on the 50K 14.1/2.8; 2021-24 25K alone 2-wk 0.2/2.2, next to LIT on the 50K 15.3/11.1.

rules: Stretched into a higher-timeframe pool: an untaken prior-day/week/month high/low is swept while the extreme is >= 3.0 x the 5m ATR away from the 18:00 VWAP; within 3 bars a 5m close back inside the level; window 08:00-15:25 ET.
Trade against the swept side (short after a high, long after a low) at the next 5m open + 1 tick; stop 1 tick beyond the extreme from the sweep to the signal bar (6-80 pts, else no trade).
Time exit 15:55 ET; one trade a day; $500 risk (floor(500 / (stop x $2)) micros, max 50); $1.90 a micro + 1 tick on entries, stop and time exits.

method: exact live-loop replay (20-day window per session) + cold-streak filter + sizing; costs included
